What does Paraty really cost in 2026?
• Schooner day on the bay: about US$ 23
• Bus to Trindade and the natural pool: R$ 5 (about US$ 1)
• Cachaça tastings in town: usually free
• Best months: April–May and September–October
3 days from US$ 235 per person, budget style, bus from Rio included.
